required.quote: An individual applying for a resident insurance producer license shall make application to the commissioner on the Uniform Application declaring under penalty of refusal, suspension, or revocation of the license that the statements made in the application are true, correct, and complete to the best of the individual's knowledge and belief.

exams.name: Insurance Producer Written Examination
exams.notes: Exam tests knowledge of lines of authority applied for, duties and responsibilities of a producer, and insurance laws and regulations of Alabama. Certain applicants are exempt (limited lines, variable life/annuity, previously licensed producers). After failing 2 exams, must wait 3 months; after 2 more failures, must wait 6 months.
exams.jurisdiction: state (administered under rules prescribed by the commissioner, may contract with outside testing service)
exams.quote: A resident individual applying for an insurance producer license shall pass a written examination unless exempt pursuant to Section 27-7-5 or 27-7-29.1.

required.quote: An insurance producer or service representative license shall remain in effect unless revoked or suspended as long as the license renewal fee set forth in Section 27-8A-9 is paid and education requirements for resident individual producers and service representatives set forth in Chapter 8A of this title are met by the due date.

available.quote: Unless denied licensure pursuant to Section 27-7-19, a nonresident person shall receive a nonresident producer license if all of the following are satisfied

requirements.value: Nonresident must submit a copy of their home state application or Uniform Application, pay required fees, and be currently licensed and in good standing in their home state. Home state must award nonresident licenses to Alabama residents on the same basis.
requirements.quote: The person's home state awards nonresident producer licenses to residents of this state on the same basis.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Any cause for which issuance of the license could have been refused had it then existed and been known to the commissioner.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Any cause for which issuance of the license could have been refused had it then existed and been known to the commissioner.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Providing incorrect, misleading, incomplete, or materially untrue information in any application or communication to the commissioner.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Providing incorrect, misleading, incomplete, or materially untrue information in any application or in any communication to the commissioner.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Obtaining or attempting to obtain a license through misrepresentation or fraud.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Obtaining or attempting to obtain a license through misrepresentation or fraud.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Intentionally misrepresenting the terms of any actual or proposed insurance contract or application for insurance.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Intentionally misrepresenting the terms of any actual or proposed insurance contract or application for insurance.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Having admitted or been found to have committed any insurance unfair trade practice or fraud.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Having admitted or been found to have committed any insurance unfair trade practice or fraud.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Inducing, persuading, or advising any policyholder to surrender or cancel any policy to their financial detriment without full disclosure.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: For inducing, persuading, or advising any policyholder to surrender or cause to be cancelled any policy of insurance issued to the policyholder by any authorized insurer in exchange for a policy offered by the licensee where the surrender or cancellation shall proximately result to the financial detriment of such policyholder, unless the policyholder shall have been fully advised of that fact by the licensee.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Using fraudulent, coercive, or dishonest practices, or demonstrating incompetence, untrustworthiness, or financial irresponsibility in the conduct of business.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Using fraudulent, coercive, or dishonest practices, or demonstrating incompetence, untrustworthiness, or financial irresponsibility in the conduct of business under a license in this state or elsewhere.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Improperly withholding, misappropriating, or converting any monies or properties belonging to insurers, insureds, or others received in the exercise of the license.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Improperly withholding, misappropriating, or converting any monies or properties belonging to the insurers, insureds, or others received by the licensee in the exercise of his or her license.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violating insurance laws or any valid order, subpoena, rule, or regulation issued by the commissioner or another state's insurance commissioner.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violating insurance laws or violating any valid order, subpoena, rule, or regulation issued by the commissioner or issued by another state's insurance commissioner.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Having been convicted of a felony.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Having been convicted of a felony.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Having an insurance producer license, or its equivalent, denied, suspended, or revoked in any other state, province, district, or territory.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Having an insurance producer license, or its equivalent, denied, suspended, or revoked in any other state, province, district, or territory.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Forging another's name to an application for insurance or to any document related to an insurance transaction.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Forging another's name to an application for insurance or to any document related to an insurance transaction.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Improperly using notes or any other reference material to complete an examination for an insurance license.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Improperly using notes or any other reference material to complete an examination for an insurance license.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Knowingly accepting insurance business from an individual who is not licensed.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Knowingly accepting insurance business from an individual who is not licensed.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to comply with an administrative or court order imposing a child support obligation.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to comply with an administrative or court order imposing a child support obligation.

definition_quote.quote: INSURANCE PRODUCER or PRODUCER. A person required to be licensed under the laws of this state to sell, solicit, or negotiate insurance.

methods_authorized.quote: SELL. To exchange a contract of insurance by any means, for money or its equivalent, on behalf of an insurance company.

value: Variable Life and Variable Annuity Products
lines_of_authority.quote: An insurance producer may receive qualification for a license in one or more of the following lines of authority

resident_license_available.quote: An individual applying for a resident insurance producer license shall make application to the commissioner on the Uniform Application

nonresident_license_available.quote: Unless denied licensure pursuant to Section 27-7-19, a nonresident person shall receive a nonresident producer license if all of the following are satisfied

business_entity_license_available.quote: A business entity acting as an insurance producer is required to obtain an insurance producer license.

designated_licensee_required_for_busines.quote: A licensed individual producer has been designated responsible for the business entity's compliance with the insurance laws, rules, and regulations of this state.

temporary_license_available.quote: The commissioner may, in his or her discretion, issue a temporary producer license without requiring an examination or prelicensing course if the commissioner deems the temporary license is necessary for the servicing of an insurance business

temporary_license_max_days.quote: The temporary license shall be valid for a period of not over six months

appointment_required_to_represent_insure.quote: No producer shall act on behalf of any insurer for which an appointment is not held under this chapter.

appointment_fee.value: Fee set forth in Section 27-4-2, paid by insurer per producer appointed; renewal appointment fee also required.
appointment_fee.quote: An insurer shall pay an appointment fee as set forth in Section 27-4-2 for each insurance producer appointed by the insurer.

appointment_termination_reporting_days.quote: An insurer or authorized representative of the insurer that terminates the appointment, employment, or contract with a producer for any reason shall within 30 days following the effective date of the termination, using a format prescribed by the commissioner, give notice of the termination to the commissioner.

fiduciary_duty_for_funds.quote: All premiums, return premiums, or other funds belonging to others received by a producer in transactions under the producer's license shall be trust funds so received by the licensee in a fiduciary capacity

misconduct_reporting_to_department_days.quote: A producer shall report to the commissioner any administrative action taken against the producer in another jurisdiction or by another governmental agency in this state within 30 days of the final disposition of the matter.

naic_producer_database_used_for_verifica.quote: The commissioner may verify the producer's licensing status through the database maintained by the NAIC, its affiliates or subsidiaries.

home_state_change_application_window_day.quote: A person licensed as an insurance producer in another state who moves to this state shall, within 90 days of establishing legal residence, make application to become a resident licensee pursuant to Section 27-7-5.

lapsed_license_reinstatement_window_days.quote: An individual insurance producer who allows his or her license to lapse, within 12 months from the due date of the renewal fee, may reinstate the same license without the necessity of passing a written examination.

fingerprint_submission_required.quote: The commissioner shall require a criminal history record check on each initial resident applicant for insurance producer license in accordance with this section. The commissioner shall require each applicant to submit a full set of fingerprints
